argv: echo "notes=$(ls corpus/knowledge/*.md | wc -l)"; for f in corpus/knowledge/*.md; do b=$(basename $f); r=$(grep -c -E "^\| *\`knowledge/$b\`" corpus/README.md); echo "$r $b"; done | sort -n | awk "{c[\$1>0]++; print} END {print \"with-first-col-row=\" c[1]+0 \" without=\" c[0]+0}"; echo "--- multi-row notes (first col):"; grep -o -E "^\| *\`knowledge/[a-z0-9-]+\.md\`" corpus/README.md | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
